verdict.rationale: Entering an online filing or payment flow without first creating an account is a fair question for a tax agency's online services, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes, both recording Akamai HTTP 403 denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and at the webapp.ftb.ca.gov host behind MyFTB and Web Pay. No published page content was retrieved that documents a keyless or file-number entry path, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
